notFound: SRS not found, or you do not have access to it.
pdfError: The PDF could not be shown. Try downloading it instead.
cancelDescription: Signing stops and the signatures collected so far are kept only in its history. Upload a new version to start again.
signedBanner: Everyone has signed ({date}). The signed PDF was added to the evidence checklist.
supersededBanner: A newer version of this SRS exists. This version is kept for history.

live.cancelled: The SRS was cancelled or replaced

tab.title: SRS sign-off
tab.note: Upload the SRS as PDF, place a signature box for each person who must acknowledge it, and send it. Each signer's signature appears in their boxes the moment they approve. When everyone has signed, the signed PDF completes the checklist item so the Requirement activity can be closed.

upload.title: Upload SRS
upload.description: PDF only. Export the document from Word as PDF first.
upload.descriptionNew: The signers and boxes of the previous version are copied — check them before sending. An unsigned earlier version is replaced.
upload.requirementHelp: When everyone has signed, the signed PDF is attached here as verified evidence.

editor.title: Signers and boxes
editor.help: Add the signers, pick one, choose Signature / Name / Date and click on the page to drop the box. Drag to move, use the corner to resize.
editor.alreadySigner: This person is already a signer
editor.noSignatureBox: Needs at least one signature box
editor.placing: Click on the page to place the {kind} box for {name}
editor.sendDescription: {count, plural, one {# signer} other {# signers}} will be notified. Boxes cannot be moved after sending.

signers.title: Signers
signers.draft: The team is still preparing the signature boxes.

sign.yourTurn: Your signature is needed — {count, plural, one {# box is} other {# boxes are}} highlighted
sign.confirmDescription: {title} V{version} — your signature goes into {count, plural, one {# box} other {# boxes}}.
sign.ack: I have read SRS version {version} and acknowledge its content.
sign.done: Signed — your signature is on the document
sign.completed: Signed — everyone has now signed the SRS

reject.title: Send the SRS back
reject.description: Tell the team what needs to change. They will upload a corrected version for signing.
reject.next: Correct the document and upload a new version from the project's SRS tab.

signature.title: My signature
signature.description: Draw your signature once. It is stamped into an SRS only when you approve it, and only you can see it here.
signature.drawHere: Sign here with your finger, pen or mouse
